status: D58 2x10 solder field registered relative to D26; 15-site mixed X9-corridor band estimated, A-number assignment open
coordinate_system: original image pixels and source PCB millimetres

d26_anchor.basis: registered D26 40-pin footprint: 19 x-pitch intervals of 2.54 mm over 1169 px and 15.24 mm row spacing over 370 px

d58_solder_field.identification: A distinct ten-joint upper row and ten-joint lower row occupy x≈3190..3730. The field lies at the reflected location of marked D58, left of D26 on the component face. Its upper-right joint joins the broad upper strip and lower-left joint joins the broad lower strip. The upper strip is followed in the overlapping solder tiles to the engraved GND terminal; the lower strip is visibly continuous left through a screw-area detour to D26.26, whose route to the engraved +5 V terminal is separately traced.
d58_solder_field.cross_check: The estimated y is within about 0.5 mm of source D43 centre y259.5, matching the owner component views that show D58 and D43 level. The 1.6 mm x difference is within the uncertainty of this single-package reflected projection.

d58_cross_face_corner_fit.fit: Reflecting the component x span 630..1160 onto solder 3730..3190 gives scale -1.019; the component and solder row separations are both about 185 px. The matching ten-contact pitch and right-facing component notch support the four corner identities. The lower front joints are partly masked by the package body, so the coordinates remain approximate photo registrations rather than independent plated-hole continuity measurements.
d58_cross_face_corner_fit.rail_corroboration: The solder-view pin10 upper-right spur joins the broad upper strip that continues through the 200534267/200537608 overlap to the terminal engraved GND; see d42-d43-orientation-audit.json. Pin20 lower-left joins the broad lower strip that is visually continuous to registered D26.26; see d26-d58-plus5-strip-review.json. D26.26 is traced to the engraved +5 V terminal. These are photographic paths, not owner meter measurements.

x9_candidate_row.meaning: The regular 15-site solder band is below D26 and physically right of D58. Site10 near (2385,2375) joins an intermediate via on B.Cu; the native crop does not directly join it to D26.28/DB6. The fourteen-wire factory count cannot identify which band site, if any, is extra. These coordinates must not be copied to numbered A pads; see x9-site10-via-review.json.

limits: D26 is a valid local package anchor and D58 four-corner geometry is matched, but absolute PCB coordinates still come from one relative solder photo. Distortion, hand-read centers, and unknown X9-band membership prevent fabrication-grade placement. Optionally meter D58.10/GND and D58.20/+5 V; independently determine site10 net and actual fourteen cable holes, then map each X9 wire before moving pads or routing copper.
